Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
Tabular figures so the width never jumps.
Roll only the digits that change.
Announce changes politely, at most once a minute.
Countdown in the user’s time zone; hide seconds when > 1 day if space is tight.
Motion with restraint
A ticker that never stops pulls attention from the rest of the page — update on real changes only.
Spec
Library-neutral contract — maps to Recharts, ECharts, D3, Visx, SwiftUI Charts or Compose.
Field
Definition
Purpose
Animated number for live counters and deadlines: Ticker rolls only the changing digits, Countdown splits time into units.
Encoding
number = value (formatted uz-UZ); motion = change; Countdown units = days / hours / minutes / seconds.
Interaction
No direct interaction; pauses when tab is hidden.
Accessibility
aria-live="polite" with throttling; reduced motion; countdown has a text equivalent (“2 days 14 hours left”).
